text:
Leah: Heads-up: scheduling a coordinated base-image hardening tomorrow 04:00 PT. Scope: rebuild minimal base, KMS signer key rotation (new version), RBAC tightening for signer SA, and ensure audit-log exports include cosign/sign events. Need owners.
Owen: I can take RBAC and IAM MR. Question: do we enforce per-key resource conditions or attach a folder-level constraint? Prefer per-key.
Marta: I'll run the rebuild and vuln scans. If scanner shows any regression, I'll flag immediately and hold promotion.
Leah: Key rotation plan: create new version (v7), sign a staging image, keep old version enabled for 48h, then revoke if no issues. Owen add bindings so build pipeline can sign but cannot decrypt.
Owen: Ack. I'll create a binding roles/redwood.kmsSigner with only cloudkms.cryptoKeySign on the specific key resource and add a condition limiting to serviceAccount:ci-build@redwood. Adding MR in a bit.
InfraBot: Preflight scanner: base-image:2026-04-02-nightly -> 1 medium (libcurl), 2 low.
Marta: libcurl patch available upstream. I'll bump package and rebuild. ETA 30m.
Leah: Audit: we need the cosign invocation to include annotations build_id and git_sha; also log entries must contain principalEmail and key_version. Owen, can you update build template?
Owen: Yup. Will add `--annotations build_id=${BUILD_ID},git_sha=${GIT_COMMIT}` and ensure cloud audit logs exported to splunk:index=images_audit.
Marta: Rebuild done with updated libcurl, re-scan -> PASS (0 high/0 medium). Pushing test image to staging.
Leah: Reminder: Dedicated pools pin certain digests. Sam (cc'd earlier) will need to accept new digest. We'll do canary push to dedicated-canary first.
Owen: MR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/pulls/533	6 includes roles/redwood.kmsSigner binding, condition, and implicit deny notes. PTAL @eng-security.
InfraBot: Cosign test sign recorded: signer_version=v7, signature=sha256:9f8e7d6c...
Marta: I ran `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKey/versions/7 gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-04-02-nightly` and verified signature attached. Pushing to canary at 04:00 PT.
Leah: Canary plan: 15% of traffic for 20m, check for auth failures, image pull latency, and error rates. If >3% error or any auth errors, pause and rollback.
Owen: Rollback playbook in MR: switch promotion to previously-signed digest, disable v7 signing (if necessary), and open incident channel. Keep v6 available for 72h before disabling.
Marta: Canary started 04:00 PT. Initial health checks green. No pull errors in first 5m.
InfraBot: Monitoring alert rule: image_pull_failures > 5 in 10m -> page eng-sre. Currently 0.
Leah: Also ensure SBOM and attestations are updated in the registry for compliance. I added a checklist item in the change ticket.
Owen: Exported audit sample: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND protoPayload.methodName=\"v1.kms.crypto.sign\"" --limit 5` shows sign by ci-build@redwood and includes request.metadata.keyVersion=v7. I'll attach to MR.
Marta: Canary 20m check: metrics ok, no regressions. Proceeding staged rollout to 60% then full in 30m.
Leah: Great work. After full rollout, we'll wait 48h, then schedule key version cleanup. If nothing to report, I'll close the compliance ticket and note the artifact digests.
InfraBot: Event: rollout-complete recorded at 05:20 PT by Leah. Audit events forwarded to splunk:index=images_audit (count=34).
Owen: Closing MR after post-release checks. Signing metadata: signer_version=v7, signature=sha256:9f8e7d6c, build_id=2026-04-02-1172.
Marta: Filing the quick blameless note in #eng-postmortems and adding SBOM link.
